description: next/ v2.0 — ISA-95 storage location (a place where material lots/sublots are held). Referenced by MaterialLot and Quant via AT_LOCATION; rooted in the equipment hierarchy via PART_OF an Area.

properties.name: warehouse
properties.description: Warehouse / building the location belongs to.

properties.name: location_type
properties.description: Type of location (e.g. rack, floor, buffer, silo).

properties.name: area_ref
properties.description: FK to Area.area_id (PART_OF) — roots the location in the site/area hierarchy.

properties.name: operational_location_class_ref
properties.description: The OperationalLocationClass (DEFINED_BY; ISA-95 OperationalLocation → OperationalLocationClass). Optional.

properties.name: parent_storage_location_ref
properties.description: The StorageLocation this StorageLocation is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 OperationalLocation MADE_UP_OF OperationalLocation). Optional.

properties.name: spatial_definition
properties.description: The spatial definition (ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.2): the location or shape as text in spatial_format. Optional.

properties.name: spatial_format
properties.description: The format of spatial_definition (e.g. WKT). Optional.

properties.name: spatial_srid
properties.description: The spatial reference system of spatial_definition (SRID). Optional.

relationships.description: The area/site section this storage location sits in.

isa95.note: ISA-95 storage location — the AT_LOCATION target for MaterialLot and Quant.
isa95.mappingNote: In B2MML StorageLocation is a field of MaterialLot and MaterialSubLot; the place it points at is an OperationalLocation. warehouse and location_type are free-text values of the source; B2MML OperationalLocation has no field for them. Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent).
